# Questions Make Suggestions
Generates suggested questions for an entity from a sample of its embedded content.
## When to use
- The entity has no saved question suggestions yet.
## How it works
1. Collects a sample of the entity's embedded text as `embeddedtext`. 2. Calls the structure named after the current step and saves each suggestion as an `aisuggestion` record with a title and prompt. 3. Renders `question_nosuggestions` if none came back. Otherwise runs `chat_questions_welcome`.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message - `entity`: The entity record - `entitymodule`: The entity's module record
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- New `aisuggestion` records and `embeddedtext`
## Implementation
- Bean `questionsMakeSuggestionsSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.QuestionsMakeSuggestionsSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

# Questions Ask
Answers a user's question from the embedded documents of the current entity, or from the whole catalog.
## When to use
- A user asks a question in an entity chat or the general assistant.
## How it works
1. Reads the user's message. 2. With an entity, uses `docids` (or the entity's embedded documents) and asks EmbeddingManager for an answer. 3. If `cancelemptyresponse` is set and nothing relevant was found, stays silent. 4. Without an entity, searches every module for embedded records that match and answers from those.
## Inputs
- `agentmessage`: The agent's chatterbox reply record; its replytoid points at the user's message - `entityid`: Optional entity to ask about - `entitymoduleid`: Module of that entity - `docids`: Optional embedded document ids to restrict the answer to - `cancelemptyresponse`: When true, send nothing if no answer is found
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `chatMessageContext`
## Outputs
- The answer as the last response
## Implementation
- Bean `questionsAskSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.QuestionsAskSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`
